## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak with concentration of losers: NVDA (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +3.63%) ABOVE TREND and ASML (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND show leadership while MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.76% | 1M: -20.69%) BELOW TREND lag — sector breadth negative (Technology: 24 stocks, sector down).

**8. Financials Outlook?**

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Relatively constructive but selective: SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND and ABBV (news +80) showing positive catalysts; UNH (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND is notable lag — Healthcare: 17 stocks, sector mildly positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and Industrials exposure via names showing confirmed strength (OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor semiconductors (ASML, AMAT) for broader confirmation. Reduce exposure to the weakest large-cap techs (ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -19.68%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.76% | 1M: -20.69%) BELOW TREND) while watching PYPL and AMZN reversals.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
